verses.text: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
lines: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

verses.text: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
lines: Sing to the glory of his name!
Offer glory and praise!

verses.text: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
lines: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds!
Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

verses.text: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.”
lines: All the earth will worship you,
and will sing to you;
they will sing to your name.”

verses.text: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
lines: Come, and see God’s deeds—
awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

verses.text: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
lines: He turned the sea into dry land.
They went through the river on foot.
There, we rejoiced in him.

verses.text: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him.
lines: He rules by his might forever.
His eyes watch the nations.
Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him.

verses.text: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
lines: Praise our God, you peoples!
Make the sound of his praise heard,

verses.text: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
lines: who preserves our life among the living,
and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

verses.text: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
lines: For you, God, have tested us.
You have refined us, as silver is refined.

verses.text: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
lines: You brought us into prison.
You laid a burden on our backs.

verses.text: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
lines: You allowed men to ride over our heads.
We went through fire and through water,
but you brought us to the place of abundance.

verses.text: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
lines: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings.
I will pay my vows to you,

verses.text: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
lines: which my lips promised,
and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

verses.text: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats.
lines: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals,
with the offering of rams,
I will offer bulls with goats.

verses.text: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
lines: Come and hear, all you who fear God.
I will declare what he has done for my soul.

verses.text: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
lines: I cried to him with my mouth.
He was extolled with my tongue.

verses.text: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
lines: If I cherished sin in my heart,
the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

verses.text: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
lines: But most certainly, God has listened.
He has heard the voice of my prayer.

verses.text: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
lines: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer,
nor his loving kindness from me.
